notes: Direct election by absolute majority of valid votes; if no candidate wins a majority, the two leading candidates contest a separate runoff. Five-year term. Turnout: 908,138 voters / 1,694,379 eligible voters. Ballots cast 908,065; invalid 10,224; valid 897,841. Candidate shares use only this round. Proposer labels retain election-era support and do not imply party membership.

title: National Council replacement election: Local interests — electoral district 8
summary: Miroslav Steržaj was elected to the National Council for Local interests — electoral district 8.
voteBasis: Candidate votes / 10455 valid ballots in this electoral body
notes: One replacement seat in the 40-member National Council. Eligible voters: 58619; participants: 11105; valid ballots: 10455. Separate electoral bodies are not combined into one percentage table. The Council represents local and functional interests. Party affiliations and ideology are unassessed. This historical replacement contest was a direct public vote, as stated in the certified report, rather than the modern indirect electoral-college procedure.
